title: Operational Cost & Latency Axes (OpenRouter-style)
description: The operational half of 'which model': cost per token, latency P50/P95, throughput, availability. Learns from OpenRouter (which exposes per-model-per-provider pricing/context) and keeps the trace OpenRouter throws away. Measurement, never certification.

axes.name: Cost per 1K tokens (USD)
axes.probe: Measure USD cost per 1,000 tokens (in+out) for a fixed probe, at the provider's list price.

axes.name: Latency P50 (ms)
axes.probe: Median time-to-token + completion for a fixed probe, across repeats.

axes.name: Latency P95 (ms)
axes.probe: 95th-percentile latency for a fixed probe (tail risk / robustness).

axes.name: Throughput (tok/s)
axes.probe: Tokens per second generated for a fixed probe.

axes.name: Availability
axes.probe: Fraction of probes that completed without a timeout/error across repeats.

axes.name: Context window
axes.probe: Context length the provider accepts (a capability ceiling).
